profile.name: 管式炉CVD配方控制组件
profile.description: 用于管式炉CVD系统的非物理配方执行软件组件。它根据预定义步骤协调炉温、质量流量控制器和压力相关参数，支持设备初始化、过程执行、参数轮询与运行日志记录，适合自动化工艺流程管理。
profile.description_en: A non-physical recipe execution software component for a tube furnace CVD system. It coordinates furnace temperature, mass flow controller settings, and pressure-related parameters according to predefined steps, and supports device initialization, process execution, parameter polling, and run logging for automated process management.

registry.description: A class for the recipes that will be used for the tube furnace CVD system
